title_zh: UI-Voyager：从失败经验中学习的自演化 GUI 智能体
one_line: Rejection fine-tuning then fork-point self-distillation from successful to failed rollouts; 4B mobile agent reaches 81.0% on AndroidWorld, beating GRPO/PPO from same init.

variance.quote: The hybrid variant consistently improves grounding accuracy, achieving SSR gains of +1.6 (Mind2Web), +5.3 (ScreenSpot-Web), +1.3 (ScreenSpot-Text), and +6.1 (VisualWebArena) over the linear-only model

title_zh: GUIDE：通过实时网络视频检索与即插即用标注消除 GUI 智能体的领域偏差
one_line: Training-free retrieval of task-relevant YouTube tutorials, VLM keyframe-pair annotation into planning/grounding knowledge injected into agents; OSWorld +4.5-7.5pp, WAA gains.
one_line_zh: 免训练地按任务检索 YouTube 教程，用 VLM 对关键帧对标注出规划与定位知识注入智能体；OSWorld 提升 4.5-7.5 个点。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate on OSWorld [ 30 ] , a benchmark of 369 real-world computer tasks executed inside live Ubuntu virtual machines.

held_out_env.quote: Given a task instruction, the retrieval agent searches YouTube for candidate tutorial videos and applies a progressive three-stage subtitle-driven filtering pipeline

variance.quote: Annotation-pipeline ablation on a balanced OSWorld subset (120 tasks, 12 per domain, Qwen3-VL-8B-thinking, average over three random seeds; score %).

strong_baselines.quote: The Watch & Learn-style ICL baseline uses the same 299 retrieved-video tasks, the same GPT-5.1 trajectory source before decomposition, K{=}2 demos, 12 steps per demo, and a 24K-character cap.

cost_reported.quote: Knowledge injection increases per-step latency (9.5 \to 11.6 s, + 2.1 s), but grounding compensates through fewer steps (15.7 vs. 16.6 on successful tasks)

component_ablation.quote: Subtitle-only already improves the 120-task subset by + 2.32pp, confirming that retrieved ASR transcripts contain useful procedural cues.

validator_check.quote: The subtitle-assisted classifier reaches 100% precision and 90.96% recall (F1 = 95.27%), preventing non-GUI videos from entering annotation

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate on OSWorld [ 30 ] , a benchmark of 369 real-world computer tasks executed inside live Ubuntu virtual machines.

S4.quote: Restoring visual pairwise annotation without OmniParser raises the gain to + 7.52pp, showing that adjacent-frame visual reasoning contributes substantially beyond transcripts.

title_zh: GPA：从演示中学习 GUI 流程自动化
one_line: Single-demo record-and-replay: detector+OCR UI graphs, SMC neighbour-based target localisation and readiness gating; 16-task pilot beats Gemini CUA, 10x faster.
one_line_zh: 单次演示录制回放：检测器+OCR 构建 UI 图，用序贯蒙特卡洛按邻居定位目标并做就绪门控；16 任务试点优于 Gemini 且快 10 倍。

online_eval.quote: We conduct a small-scale pilot study of 16 desktop GUI tasks to compare GPA against a VLM-based baseline: the Gemini computer-use agent ( gemini-3-pro ) that executes a demonstrated workflow description.

held_out_env.quote: For each task, GPA is given a single recorded demonstration and then replays the workflow using its visual graph retrieval, context-node-based matching, readiness checks, and bounded retry logic.

variance.quote: We report average runtime and success rate over the tasks in each difficulty group.

strong_baselines.quote: The Gemini baseline is given the same demonstrated video and process theml into textual form, and use it to guide its action autoregressively during execution.

cost_reported.quote: GPA achieves 100\% success across both difficulty levels while being roughly 10\times faster ( 33.74 s vs. 329.31 s).

component_ablation.quote: Although this is a pilot-scale study, it is sufficient to test whether the practical trends are consistent with the design goals of GPA.

evidence_level.quote: We conduct a small-scale pilot study of 16 desktop GUI tasks to compare GPA against a VLM-based baseline: the Gemini computer-use agent ( gemini-3-pro ) that executes a demonstrated workflow description.

title_zh: 不要盲目行动：基于动作效果验证与自我纠正的鲁棒 GUI 自动化
one_line: Policy outputs verification of previous action plus expected effect; SFT on synthetic no-change failures then offline GRPO; better recovery, AndroidWorld 25.1% at 7B.
one_line_zh: 策略逐步输出对上一步的验证与预期效果；先用合成无变化失败样本 SFT，再离线 GRPO；恢复率提升，7B 在 AndroidWorld 达 25.1%。

online_eval.quote: Our offline evaluation exploits the failure idempotency of GUI environments to construct a pseudo-online simulation: correct actions advance to ground-truth next screens, while incorrect actions return the unchanged screen.

held_out_env.quote: Cross-distribution results on AITW-Gen and GUI Odyssey further validate generalization.

variance.quote: VeriGUI-7B reaches 59.7% and 25.1% respectively, outperforming all open-source baselines including UI-S1-7B.

title_zh: MAESTRO：在带 GUI 的对话智能体中依据用户偏好调整界面并引导导航
one_line: Conversational GUI agent keeps preference memory, adapts GUI in place and suggests backtracking; N=33 movie-ticketing user study shows fewer preference violations.
one_line_zh: 对话式 GUI 智能体维护偏好记忆、就地调整界面并建议回溯；33 人购票用户研究显示偏好违背更少。

online_eval.quote: Through a controlled experiment (N=33), we demonstrated that MAESTRO improved decision quality in movie ticketing

held_out_env.quote: While the approach is applicable to domains where a CAG can be used, we focus on a specific domain—a movie ticketing agent—to demonstrate it.

variance.quote: There was a significant main effect of condition, with MAESTRO reducing violation counts compared to the baseline ( \beta = -0.80, SE = 0.40, z = -1.99, p = .047).

strong_baselines.quote: The baseline agent thus represents a modern, GUI-integrated, task-oriented chatbot: its tools are limited to standard GUI interactions, namely selecting an option and moving to the next or previous stage

cost_reported.quote: While overall Task Completion Time (DV4) was longer for MAESTRO, the difference was not statistically significant.

component_ablation.quote: The primary comparison is Condition (Baseline vs. MAESTRO), capturing the integrated effect of the agent’s decision-support approach.

validator_check.quote: We classified all user utterances, i.e., each message, into three functional categories using LLM-assisted coding validated against manual annotations

title_zh: Web 智能体能力的结构化蒸馏实现泛化
